newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UOB sees Sing dlr volatile, then stronger.
newsitem.headline: UOB sees Sing dlr volatile, then stronger.

text.p: Singapore's United Overseas Bank Ltd said on Thursday it expected continued short-term volatility in the Singapore dollar but more strength over the longer term.
UOB chairman and chief executive officer Wee Cho Yaw told reporters after the bank released its 1996 financial results:
"I think long-term the Singapore dollar will continue to be strong...short-term it may be very volatile and could continue to be weaker."
The Singapore dollar has fallen to around 1.445 to the U.S. dollar over the last three months from a high of around 1.395.
